# Cherie (06, engineer) — BAD-015

## Brief
Objective: make the "Set the profiles_web password" step in .github/workflows/server-deploy.yml actually set the password, by feeding the SQL to psql on stdin so psql's variable substitution applies, and prove it against a real Postgres rather than a stub.

What happened. After PR #349 fixed the pooler-url handling, the dispatched Server deploy run 34927908869 reached the database and psql answered:
  ERROR:  syntax error at or near ":"
  LINE 1: alter role profiles_web with password :'pw'
The `:'pw'` reached the server literally. psql documents that a `-c` string containing only SQL is sent to the server as a single request without going through psql's own parser, so `:'pw'` (and any `:var`) is never substituted in `-c`. Substitution applies to input psql reads as a script: stdin, `-f`, or lines after a `\set`. The stub-psql dry run in #349 could not see this, because the stub never parsed anything.

The fix, in that step only:
 - Keep everything up to the psql call as it is (the pooler-url handling from #349, PGPASSWORD for the superuser, `-v ON_ERROR_STOP=1`, `-v pw="$PROFILES_DB_PASSWORD"`, `-q`).
 - Replace `-c "alter role profiles_web with password :'pw'"` with the same statement delivered on stdin, for example `printf '%s\n' "alter role profiles_web with password :'pw';" | PGPASSWORD=… psql "$url" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v pw="$PROFILES_DB_PASSWORD" -q`, and keep the success and failure branches exactly as they are (the `if …; then echo "profiles_web's password is set"; else ::error …` shape). `set -uo pipefail` is already on, so the pipeline's psql status is the one tested. Do not use `-c`. Do not splice the password into the SQL string or the URL; `-v pw` with `:'pw'` is the whole point.
 - Update the step's comment to say why stdin and not `-c`, naming run 34927908869.
 - If server/README.md or docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-14-public-profile-pages-design.md § 5 show the `-c` form, change them to the stdin form.

Proof, against a REAL psql this time (quote the decisive lines in `member result`):
 - Start a throwaway Postgres on podman: `podman run -d --name pgscratch-bad015-pw -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=bt -p 55434:5432 public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgres:17.6.1.008`; wait for it to accept connections; create the role there with `podman exec pgscratch-bad015-pw psql -U postgres -c "create role profiles_web login"` (the container has psql; this Mac does not).
 - Run the step's exact psql invocation (the pipeline you wrote, with the same flags) with `podman exec -i pgscratch-bad015-pw psql -U postgres …` standing in for `psql "$url"` (the only difference being how the connection is addressed), with `-v pw=` set to a value containing a single quote and a colon (for example `a'b:c`) to prove the quoting: it must exit 0 and print nothing. Then prove the password took: `podman exec pgscratch-bad015-pw psql -U postgres -tAc "select rolpassword is not null from pg_authid where rolname='profiles_web'"` prints `t`, and a login as profiles_web with that password over TCP (`podman exec -e PGPASSWORD="a'b:c" pgscratch-bad015-pw psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U profiles_web -d postgres -tAc "select current_user"`) prints `profiles_web`. Then show the old `-c` form failing against the same container with the same syntax error, so the difference is on record.
 - Run the full step body once more through the stub-psql harness from the previous fix at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ericlugo-Personal-BadTakes/32d19997-5c89-4794-b49e-16c300a19e7a/scratchpad/dryrun.sh (adapt it for stdin: the stub should print what it received on stdin) to show the shell around psql still behaves: the real-format URL path prints "profiles_web's password is set"; the malformed-file and empty-secret paths are unchanged.
 - `actionlint .github/workflows/server-deploy.yml` (at /opt/homebrew/bin/actionlint): exit 0.
 - Remove the container when done. Never run the real step, never touch production, never `supabase login`.

REAL POSTGRES (public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgres:17.6.1.008 on podman, pw=a'b:c — a quote AND a colon; container removed, podman ps -a shows nothing):
 1. old -c form, identical flags -> 'ERROR:  syntax error at or near ":"' / 'LINE 1: alter role profiles_web with password :'pw'' / exit 1 — byte-identical to the CI failure.
 2. after it, rolpassword is not null -> f.
 3. stdin form -> no output, exit 0.
 4. rolpassword is not null -> t.

Not over 127.0.0.1: this image's pg_hba trusts loopback (a wrong password logged in there, so that test proves nothing); used the container's own 10.88.0.4, which matches its 'host all all 10.0.0.0/8 scram-sha-256' rule — a wrong password there -> 'FATAL:  password authentication failed for user "profiles_web"', exit 2.
 6. second run of the stdin form -> silent, exit 0 (idempotent, as a rotation needs).

STUB HARNESS (dryrun.sh, stub adapted to echo stdin): all 8 cases unchanged. Malformed host / two lines / not-a-URL / missing file still give their redacted ::error:: and exit 0; empty secret still the ::warning::. Extra check because the call became a pipeline (failbranch.sh, stub exits 3): the else branch fires and reports 'exit 3' — psql's status, not printf's, via the step's existing pipefail.
